findings.text: no case in this file passes a mapping-shaped options value, so the mapping-branch guard added at reckon/_store.py:1556 can be deleted without reddening either the gate or the declared mutation, and that half of the change is unprotected.

the guard also fires for an entry carrying no "value" key at all, so an empty option object now reports "carries a null 'value'" where the removed read at :1536 fell back to the empty string and the case reported "carries no 'value'" — the refusal is right and the message now misnames the input a caller must fix.

an object option with a valid value and a null label still stringifies the label, so {"value": "x", "label": None} yields labels {'x': 'None'} while the mapping branch below deliberately falls back to the value for a null label; this is the sibling of the repaired stringification, pre-existing and unchanged by this diff, so it is scored on no dimension and is named only so the coordinator can dispatch it rather than read it as a regression introduced here.
